title: Tuning collagen and collagen-alginate mechanics through extrusion bioprinting process parameters
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46591-46601
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03922C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Grace Hu, Karla Gutierrez Cebrero, Nandita Venkataraman, Dharneedar Ravichandran, Yunzhi Lin, Zeqing Jin, Zev J. Gartner, Grace X. Gu
Collagen-based scaffolds can be tailored by adjusting bioprinting process parameters. Here, bioink composition, crosslinking duration, and infill density are characterized to determine resulting shape fidelity and mechanical behaviors.
